concerns.text: Task T005c3 (Document Data Source Deviation) lists dependency on T005c4, but T005c4 (Document Plan Deviation) is listed AFTER T005c3 in the file. T005c3 requires the deviation document created by T005c4 to exist before it can write the JSON summary. This is a consumer-before-producer violation.

Task T005c1_validate depends on T005c4 and T005c3. However, T005c3 depends on T005c4. The ordering in the file places T005c1_validate after T005c3, which is correct, but T005c3 is placed BEFORE T005c4 in the file. The file order must be T005c4 -> T005c3 -> T005c1_validate to respect the data-flow.

Task T005c1_fetch depends on T005c1_validate. T005c1_validate is placed after T005c1_fetch in the file (T005c1_fetch appears before T005c1_validate). This violates the producer-consumer rule: the validation of the deviation document must complete before the fetch logic can branch based on that validation.

Task T005d_state_sync depends on T005b and T005c1_fetch. In the file, T005d_state_sync appears BEFORE T005c1_fetch. The state synchronization (archiving raw data) cannot occur until the climate data (T005c1_fetch) has been downloaded.

Task T015b (Preprocessing) depends on T051 (Streaming), T015a (Species List), T005b (Data Download), and T005c1_fetch (Climate Data). In the file, T015b appears BEFORE T051, T015a, and T005c1_fetch. The preprocessing pipeline cannot run before the streaming utility, species list, and climate data are produced.
Task T013 (Integration Test) depends on T015b. In the file, T013 appears BEFORE T015b. The integration test cannot verify the pipeline before the pipeline implementation (T015b) exists.
Task T023a_gamm_gp depends on T015b (preprocessed data). In the file, T023a_gamm_gp appears BEFORE T015b. The GAMM model cannot be fitted before the preprocessed data is generated.
Task T030 (Compute Weekly Centroids) depends on T015b. In the file, T030 appears BEFORE T015b. The trajectory analysis cannot run before the preprocessed data is available.

Task T031c_permutation depends on T030, T031a_manifold, T031b_manifold. In the file, T031c_permutation appears BEFORE T030 and T031a_manifold. The permutation test cannot run before the trajectory statistics and shift vectors are computed.

Task T025c (Apply FDR Correction) depends on T025d and T031c_permutation. In the file, T025c appears BEFORE T025d and T031c_permutation. The FDR correction cannot be applied before the permutation test results are generated.

Task T033a3 (Calculate CI Width Metrics) depends on T033a1, T033a2, T033b, and T025c. In the file, T033a3 appears BEFORE T033a1, T033a2, T033b, and T025c. The metrics cannot be calculated before the confidence intervals and FDR results are generated.

Task T043 (Calculate and Report All Success Criteria) depends on T043a, T043b, T043c1, T043c2, T043d, T025c, T027, T033a3. In the file, T043 appears BEFORE T043a, T043b, T043c1, T043c2, T043d, T025c, T027, T033a3. The final report cannot be generated before the individual success criteria reports are created.

Task T005c5 (Pre-Execution Ordering Validator) is placed in Phase 7, but it is designed to validate the ordering of tasks in tasks.md itself. If placed in Phase 7, it runs too late to prevent execution of out-of-order tasks. It should be in Phase 0 or Phase 0.5, before any data processing tasks (T005a, T005b, etc.) are executed.

Task T060 (Verify Task Ordering for Phenology Metrics) depends on T005c5. In the file, T060 appears BEFORE T005c5. The specific ordering check cannot run before the general ordering validator is implemented.

Task T070 (Enforce Strict Real-Data Download Fails) depends on T005a and T015a. In the file, T070 appears in Phase 9, but T005a and T015a are in Phase 0 and Phase 3 respectively. While the dependency is listed, the placement in Phase 9 (Revision) suggests it's a post-hoc fix. If it's a prerequisite for data integrity, it should be integrated into the data download tasks (T005a, T015a) or placed in Phase 0/0.5 to prevent execution of downstream tasks with bad data.

Task T076 (Verify Data Source Ratification Logic) depends on T005c1_validate. In the file, T076 appears in Phase 9, but T005c1_validate is in Phase 0.5. This logic should be part of the initial download task (T005c1_fetch) or the validation task (T005c1_validate) itself, not a separate task in Phase 9 that runs after the data has already been fetched.

Task T079 (Implement Data Quality Flag Propagation) depends on T015b. In the file, T079 appears in Phase 9, but T015b is in Phase 3. The data quality flag propagation is a core part of the preprocessing pipeline (T015b) and should be implemented there, not as a separate task in Phase 9 that runs after the data has been processed and modeled.

Task T080 (Validate Shift Vector Magnitude Thresholds) depends on T031b_manifold. In the file, T080 appears in Phase 9, but T031b_manifold is in Phase 5. The validation of shift vectors should be part of the shift detection task (T031b_manifold) or the trajectory analysis task (T031c_permutation), not a separate task in Phase 9 that runs after the results have been generated.
